_about: Original songs for the built-in storybook synth (TalesOfDorlune/Audio/SongSynth.swift). instruments: additive voices; partials are [frequency ratio, level, decay per second] (decay 0 = held), plus attack/release seconds, vibrato [semitones, Hz, delay s], voices + detune (cents) for chorus, breath and click noise, gain. 'drums' is the kit: K kick, S brush snare, H hi-hat, T tambourine, C cymbal, R rim/shaker. Each track: instrument, volume, pan (-1 left..1 right), reverb (send 0..1), notes. Song reverb = hall level. Notes are NOTE+OCTAVE:STEPS (e.g. F#5:2), chords join with + (C4+E4+G4:4), - is a rest, | is a bar line. A step is an eighth note at the song's tempo (quarter notes per minute). loops: false plays once. Tracks with wave (square | triangle | noise, duty) instead of instrument still play as old chiptune voices. tools/music_preview.py renders any song to WAV without a Mac.
